guides.title: PocketTTS Multilingual · Language and voice
guides.description: Use Language and voice in PocketTTS Multilingual.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Choose the speech language and voice
steps.body: Use the language choices listed on this page and select the one matching the speech you intend to produce. Read the selected voice and reference-audio options separately. Confirm the displayed values after an intentional edit; changing generation settings will not correct the wrong language choice.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Reference routing differences
steps.body: Some routes use reference audio; others do not. Read the controls shown for this backend and only supply samples where they are accepted. Mismatched reference and language settings explain many unexpected accents in output.

guides.title: PocketTTS Multilingual · Startup
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Load and confirm readiness
steps.body: Startup options decide how and when the multilingual backend loads. Pick a load policy that suits your workflow. If speech is unavailable straight after launch, wait for startup to finish and verify with a short spoken line before changing anything else.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Recover a stalled startup
steps.body: If startup does not complete, note the reported state and revert the last startup change. Repeated restarts with the same setting rarely help. Verify recovery by producing one short line in the chosen language.

guides.title: PocketTTS Multilingual · Generation
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Adjust audio generation
steps.body: Generation holds audio shaping controls such as speed or clarity. Change one value and generate a short sample in the chosen language. If intelligibility drops after a change, restore the previous value rather than stacking more edits.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Compare speech in the selected language
steps.body: A later short phrase in the selected language is a useful synthesis check. Compare pronunciation and clarity using the same text and voice before changing another generation value. If the language sounds wrong, recheck the language selection and reference rather than assuming the backend auto-detects it.

guides.title: PocketTTS Multilingual · Voice tag rules
guides.description: Understand the shared voice-tag rules alongside this TTS provider.

steps.title: Read the default voice guidance
steps.body: Voice tag rules describe how NC interprets voice tags alongside this backend. Read the default guidance before changing it; backend selection and reference-audio selection are separate choices. Keeping the existing rules gives you a known baseline for later speech comparisons.

steps.title: Distinguish rules from actual playback
steps.body: A saved rule expresses how voice tags should be interpreted, not proof that a backend accepted the reference or produced audio. A later controlled spoken reply is needed to verify routing. If output changes unexpectedly, compare the rules with their previous text before changing provider settings.
